mechanism_narrative: A stronger labor market, as measured by the level of total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS), directly supports corporate earnings growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns show a negative correlation with PAYEMS (Rank IC < -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 5.0%, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) and very low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals that the Federal Reserve is maintaining an accommodative stance despite inflation, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate sustained consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, the 60-day forward returns show a negative correlation with HOUST (Rank IC < -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level above 15700 billion dollars (indicating robust economic growth) signals strong corporate earnings potential, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 > 15700, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production level (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing activity and supply chain health, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns show a negative correlation with INDPRO (Rank IC < -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL level above 235 (indicating elevated inflation) triggers market concerns about future monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 235, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above 425,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 425000, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
